rows.text: TACHOGRAPHS ON PUBLIC SERVICE VEHICLES

This form is to be completed and submitted at time of test if a vehicle does not have a calibrated tachograph fitted according to the requirements of IM26 of the Public Service Vehicle Inspection Manual and the presenter wishes to declare it to be exempt. One of the following reasons should be selected :
• Vehicle was manufactured prior to 1 January 1947.
• Vehicle is over 25 years old and is not used commercially for carriage of passengers.
• Vehicle propelled by steam.
• Vehicle is not capable by design of exceeding 40km/h under its own power on level road.
• Vehicle is only used on regular scheduled services with a route length not exceeding 50 km (also includes former stage carriage type buses presented by a vehicle dealer).
• Vehicle is used by or on behalf of a relevant NHS body or other authorised body to provide ambulance services or to transport medical personnel.
• Vehicle is used by a local authority for relevant social services functions.
• Vehicle is used by an airport authority within airport perimeters or used on roads inside hub facilities such as a port, inter-port or railway terminal.
• Vehicle is used by or under the control of the armed services, civil defence, fire services or forces responsible for maintaining public order.
• Vehicle is used in emergencies or rescue operations (including humanitarian aid).

• Vehicle is used for driving instruction and examination with a view to obtaining a driving licence or certificate of professional competence and is not used for the commercial carriage of goods or passengers.
• Vehicle is used on an island not exceeding 2300 square kilometres in area not linked to the rest of Great Britain by a bridge, tunnel or ford open to motor vehicles.
DECLARATION : I declare that vehicle registration mark
is exempt from the
tachograph fitment and calibration requirement for reason
(1-12 as applicable) above.
Signature
Name
Position in Business
Date
WARNING : It is an offence to make a declaration knowing it to be untrue.
Please note that the information contained in this declaration may be passed onto DVSA Enforcement staff for information and possible further investigation.
For further guidance, search “Tachograph rules for passenger vehicles” on www.gov.uk

Data Protection - We collect, use and store your personal data in order to confirm this declaration and to advise our Enforcement officers. We may share your personal data if we have a lawful reason. For example as part of a criminal investigation, to prevent fraud or to inform a Public Inquiry. Find out more at www.gov.uk/dvsa/privacy
DVSA 0510
January 2020

context: This is a wholly fictional vehicle-test declaration for a benchmark, not a submitted regulatory declaration. The placeholder vehicle registration mark is DEMO-PSV-01; it does not identify a real registered vehicle. The fictional bus has no calibrated tachograph and is used only on regular scheduled services with a 28 km route length. In the source's ordered list, that is reason number 5, so enter 5 in the reason blank. It is a modern conventional bus used commercially on a mainland route, not a historic or steam vehicle, not limited to 40km/h, and not an ambulance, social-services, airport, armed-services, emergency, driving-instruction or island vehicle. The responsible fictional person's Name is Jordan Ellis, Position in Business is Fleet Manager, and the Date is 18/09/2026. In the Signature field enter the typed placeholder Jordan Ellis (synthetic signature); this is not an authentic signature.
normalization_notes: Complete single-page source retained: title, introductory instructions, all twelve exemption reasons in printed order, entire declaration, six original fillable blanks, warning, enforcement notice, guidance link, data-protection notice and version footer.

The twelve printed round bullets are not checkboxes. The source asks for a reason number in a single text blank (1-12 as applicable); retain that text field and do not invent checkbox or dropdown controls.

The vehicle mark and reason are separate inline blanks. Logical colspans preserve each blank's relation to the surrounding declaration text; there are no nested tables, rowspans or branch-dependent controls.
The four signing captions are below their respective entry lines in the PDF. Explicit label_position coordinates preserve that direction; do not silently move labels above the targets.
Only the DVSA logo/crest and decorative font/line styling are excluded. The source privacy notice is retained; no filled real personal data are imported.
All synthetic names and vehicle identifiers are fictional; the signature is a typed placeholder. The historical January 2020 form is evaluated as a source artifact, not as current regulatory advice.
The issuer is shared with the learner-practice source, but this is a different official PDF, landing page and regulatory business family; it is not a variant or slice of that source.
